key_insight: The paper presents an LLM-driven pipeline that automatically builds and incrementally updates a consistent knowledge graph for ML interatomic potential (MLIP) models.
engineering_relevance: This enables scalable tracking, comparison, and querying of fast-changing materials ML models, helping researchers and engineers manage model metadata and provenance more reliably.
method: Extract information from papers and articles using LLM-based information extraction.
Validate and correct graph content with SHACL constraints in an iterative loop.
Build the knowledge graph model-by-model to preserve consistency and simplify future updates.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a knowledge graph constructed from models listed in the Matbench Discovery leaderboard and demonstrates queryable insights from it.
watch_item: The approach depends on accurate extraction and constraint design, so errors or incomplete SHACL rules could propagate into the graph.
paper_title: Automatically Building and Updating a Knowledge Graph of MLIP Models
